evidence.claim: Kirby may be a second-order beneficiary of sulphuric-acid dislocation if disrupted global acid trade routes increase demand for qualified US chemical tank-barge logistics, but no company-specific acid-cargo evidence has been verified yet.

Thermon may have second-order exposure to AI data-center liquid-cooling validation through load banks, temperature management, or commissioning systems, but commercial customer evidence remains unverified.

Preformed Line Products may benefit from AI-driven utility T&D and substation upgrades via line hardware and connectors, but the link to data-center interconnection demand is not yet directly evidenced.
MACOM may have hidden InP photonics exposure inside a broader RF/microwave and photonic semiconductor portfolio, but revenue materiality and substrate bottleneck sensitivity remain unverified.
Ivanhoe Electric may become exposed to sulphuric-acid availability if its copper project advances using leach or ISR methods, but acid intensity, sourcing, and economic sensitivity remain unverified.

ATI may have second-order tungsten or defense-material exposure, but the provided candidate data explicitly flags the need to verify whether meaningful tungsten alloy or powder products remain after past tungsten-business divestitures.

American Tungsten & Antimony is a speculative OTC micro-cap candidate for domestic tungsten/antimony processing optionality, requiring verification of restart economics, feedstock, permitting, funding, and customer qualification.

Applied Optoelectronics could be downstream of InP substrate demand through optical transceivers and lasers, but whether it uses InP-based lasers and whether AI datacenter customers drive material demand remain unverified.

Guardian Metal Resources is an exploration-stage tungsten and critical-minerals candidate whose relevance depends on resource quality, metallurgy, permitting, infrastructure, financing, government support, and downstream validation.

Vale is a reference large-cap for Indonesian nickel and possible HPAL acid-feedstock sensitivity; verification is needed on whether Vale-controlled or linked projects use HPAL and how sulphuric acid is sourced.

memory_update.text: KEX maps to the sulphur/sulphuric-acid hotspot only as an indirect chemical-logistics hypothesis; next layer must verify actual sulphuric-acid or acid-adjacent cargo exposure and pricing/utilization sensitivity.

THR maps to AI liquid-cooling infrastructure as a testing/commissioning hypothesis rather than direct cooling hardware; survival requires proof of commercial liquid-cooled load-bank or data-center temperature-management orders.
PLPC maps to AI power/grid stress through utility T&D hardware and substation connectors; company-specific evidence must show accelerating utility order demand in data-center-heavy regions.
MTSI maps to the InP hotspot as an adjacent photonics semiconductor candidate; key unknowns are InP product materiality, optical-interconnect exposure, and substrate sourcing constraints.
AAOI maps downstream of InP through optical transceivers, but the claim is speculative until laser technology, InP use, AI customer demand, and substrate shortage sensitivity are verified.
IE and VALE are more likely acid-cost sensitivity checks than clean beneficiaries; the node is useful for falsifying sulphuric-acid bottleneck impact on copper/nickel economics.

ATI, ATALF, and GMTL map to tungsten/defense-material supply, but ATI requires tungsten revenue verification and ATALF/GMTL should remain speculative micro-cap/developer exceptions until permitting, funding, processing, and customer validation evidence improves.
Need primary-source filings and transcripts for every candidate in this chunk; current evidence supports hotspot nodes better than ticker-specific economics.
Need market-cap, liquidity, valuation, and analyst-coverage checks before ranking; discovery-lane labels are provisional and should not be interpreted as investment recommendations.

Need falsification triggers: acid trade normalization, InP capacity additions/permit relief, utility capex slowdown, data-center commissioning demand failing to materialize, or tungsten policy interest not converting into qualified orders.

summary: Mapped ticker-to-node relationships for the candidate chunk across sulphur/sulphuric-acid logistics, AI data-center thermal/power validation, grid-interconnection hardware, InP optical supply chain, copper/nickel reagent exposure, and tungsten/defense materials. Most relationships remain hypothesis/speculation because the available evidence supports the hotspot nodes, but not yet company-specific revenue materiality. Strongest relationship candidates for next verification are KEX for acid-adjacent chemical logistics, THR for liquid-cooled data-center commissioning/load-bank validation, PLPC for utility T&D hardware pull-through, and MTSI/AAOI for downstream InP/optical exposure. Micro-cap tungsten developers remain speculative exceptions.
